title: With no row context every row of the relation is a current row: OFFSET ( -1, ... ) returns all rows but the last

source.quote: Therefore, the result contains all rows except the last one.
source.supports: without a row context, VALUES of the column in the filter context gives every value, every row is current, and the results are put together

derivation: No row context and no filter: the matching table is every product, so OFFSET runs for Bike, Helmet, Lock and Scooter. Their previous rows are none, Bike, Helmet and Lock.
